static_traits.name: 林佩然
static_traits.family_status: Lives with spouse and two children
static_traits.social_status: 与同事的关系因Self-doubt与比较而Tension, estrangement
static_traits.medical_history: not yet曾接受心理治疗；not yet出现过类似心理问题；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude，表达清晰，能具体描述问题，愿意配合，倾向Self-doubt与自我批评

basic_info.main_problem: 尽管会演奏多种乐器，但我without法掌握其中任何一个，这让我感到挫败和not够好。
basic_info.core_demands: 我希望解决持续的自卑感，重建对自身音乐能力的信心；在练习或演出时更有自信、减少与他人的比较，并能够“without自我批评地完成一次演奏”，重新享受音乐。

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough/not够好

special_situations.event: 开始教授更高级的Student，直接看到Student的高水平演奏与技术
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果Student比我更强，就证明我not配当老师；我必须比Student更强才能称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 设定not切实际的目标、加班练习以证明自己
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会看出我not行，我会被揭穿

special_situations.event: Some mistakes occur or difficult passages are encountered during practice or performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能完美演奏，就说明我have not真正掌握任何乐器
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复练到完美、严厉自我批评
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我根本have not掌握任何乐器

special_situations.event: 与同事或Student比较，看到他们的亮点与成就
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: do not人比我优秀就意味着I am not good enough、not该享受音乐
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 寻求他人认可以缓解Anxiety，同时减少与同事交流

special_situations.event: 收到他人的正面反馈或被认可时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人的认可not算数，只有达到我设定的极高标准才算有能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 继续提高标准、忽视正面证据
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些表扬并not代表我真的有能力

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被视为胜任且优秀的Musician与Teacher，得到认可并享受音乐的意义感
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被看穿not够专业、被评判与negate，最终被贴上“骗子”的标签
defense_goal: 通过not断提高标准与自我批评来避免被看作not够好
保持与同事的距离以减少被比较和被评判
寻求外部认可以暂时缓解not安

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、随时可能被揭穿的Teacher/Musician
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔的评判者（更优秀的同事与Student）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当想到向配偶或同事表达困难、寻求支持时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes expressing will burden the other person, or draw others' judgment and contempt
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以委婉、克制的语气强调“我not想麻烦do not人”，转而自我消化问题，减少情感暴露与求助请求。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当面对Student/同事的高水平表现或他人的沉默与中性反馈时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将内在的羞耻与Self-denialProjection为他人的负面看法（他们会认为我not行）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use模糊与回避式表达，降低自我暴露，强调他人“可能会看not起我”，从而避免进一步深入讨论。

manifestations: The experience of enjoying music decreases; practice and performance are dominated by self-criticism
Measures self-worth by others' standards; finds it hard to experience self-consistency at work
outcomes: Declining sleep quality与注意力受损

manifestations: not与支持性的配偶分享困难与感受
与同事疏离，因比较而减少交流
outcomes: 可用支持not yet被利用，Increased subjective sense of isolation
负性情绪自我循环加重

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在练习/演出时高度关注错误并放大其意义
担心给他人带来负担而not求助

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 想寻求配偶支持却选择忍耐与自我消化
将对外求助的需求转为加倍练习、提高标准来压住Anxiety

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 固守“必须比Student更强才称职”的绝对标准
将他人的认可视为“not算数”，只有达到自订高标准才承认自己有能力

positive_force: Has a supportive spouse（可提供情感支持）
Having a professional foundation of many years of music training and multi-instrument performance ability
Proactively seeks counseling and is willing to try structured behavioral experiments and records
negative_force: 强烈的自我比较与冒名顶替感
设定not切实际的目标并依赖外部认可来确认自我价值
认知歪曲：心理过滤、negate积极、预测not yet来、过度概括
睡眠与专注受影响，Decline in work performance、与同事疏离

target_behavior.behavior: 在练习与演出中进行过度自我批评与比较，伴随Anxiety与回避倾向
antecedent: 看到同事或Student的高水平表现
target_behavior.core_reason: 认知歪曲与冒名顶替感驱动（将个do not失误泛化为“完全not行”，预测被揭穿）
target_behavior.function: Avoids being judged and failure, trying to gain a sense of control through self-criticism
target_behavior.consequence: Work stress and burnout increase, enjoyment of music declines, and he becomes distant from colleagues

target_behavior.behavior: 设定not切实际的目标并持续寻求外部认可
antecedent: 面对高级教学任务或专业评估
target_behavior.core_reason: 自我价值过度依赖外部认可与绝对标准，negate正向证据
target_behavior.function: 短暂缓解not安、获得他人赞许以维持自尊
target_behavior.consequence: 压力与Worsened self-negation，睡眠与专注受影响，长期效果适得其反
